commitResults.messageTitle: Docs: Explain the list shown after edit and remark
commitResults.messageBody:
A successful edit or remark clears any find filter but keeps the sort
order. Neither guide says this, so a user who loses their search
results after an edit may think the command misbehaved.

State the behaviour in the UG edit and remark sections, and add a
design consideration to the DG explaining why the filter is cleared
while the sort order is kept.
Docs: Explain the list shown after edit and remark

commitResults.messageTitle: UI: Bundle Inter font for consistent card heights
commitResults.messageBody:
The theme uses Segoe UI and Consolas, which ship only with Windows. On
macOS JavaFX silently falls back to the system font, whose different
metrics make the wrapped card labels measure taller, so person cards
show a large empty gap below their content.

Bundle Inter (SIL Open Font License) and use it for the whole theme so
every OS renders the same text metrics. Drop the 150px preferred width
on the card column so labels are not measured against a narrow width.

Fixes #242

commitResults.messageTitle: EditCommand: List matches when UUID is ambiguous
commitResults.messageBody:
When more than one person matches the UUID given to edit, the error
only asks for a more specific identifier. The user has to open the data
file to see how many more characters to type, while delete and remark
already list the full UUID and name of each match.

Make edit list the matches with the same message as delete and remark.

Move the formatUuids helper, previously copied in DeleteCommand and
RemarkCommand, into Messages so all three commands share it.

Update the User Guide, which said only delete and remark list matches.
Bundle Inter font for consistent card heights
List matches when edit gets an ambiguous UUID

tests for parsing and saving remarks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Correct Add command sequence diagram notation
commitResults.messageBody:
The Add diagrams show premature returns, pre-existing created objects,
and static methods as instance calls. These obscure the actual flow.

Show constructor lifeline starts, class-level calls, and separate chained
calls. Connect successful execution with a reference frame, clarify the
notation in the guide, and regenerate the three diagram images.

commitResults.messageTitle: Restore activation bars in Add sequence diagrams
commitResults.messageBody:
The Add diagrams omit activation bars and include explanatory notes
that add clutter. Restore execution bars and remove the UML notes.

Keep complete calls and returns inside each alternative, update the
surrounding captions, and regenerate all three PNG diagrams.
Small Improvements to UG and DG

Adding repeated UNKNOWN names is supported, but JSON loading and list
reconstruction reject them. Restarting can therefore discard valid
contacts when a later command saves the empty address book.

Apply the add-time uniqueness rule during loading and reconstruction.
Cover saving, reopening, and saving again while preserving both UUIDs.

Validation: Full test suite and both Checkstyle tasks pass.

commitResults.messageTitle: Target contact updates and deletion by UUID
commitResults.messageBody:
Contacts can have identical fields and different UUIDs. Equality-based
lookups select the first matching contact, so editing or deleting a later
contact can affect the wrong record and corrupt deletion history.

Locate replacement and removal targets by UUID, and track the deleted
contact's actual position. Preserve field-based Person equality for
existing value comparisons. Add command, persistence, missing-target,
and restoration-order regression coverage.
